interest: Pre-WWII U.S. intelligence appraisals and career dossiers on pivotal commanders like Nagumo and Nagano before Pearl Harbor.
overview: This file contains U.S. State Department and Office of Naval Intelligence records from 1939 to 1941 concerning personnel, organization, and high-level command changes within the Imperial Japanese Navy. It includes diplomatic and naval telegrams reporting significant leadership reassignments, notably Admiral Osami Nagano replacing Prince Fushimi as Chief of the Naval General Staff, alongside an extensive 1940 confidential intelligence register of senior officers and nineteen standardized personnel characteristic data sheets compiling service records and intelligence appraisals for flag officers such as Chuichi Nagumo and Naokuni Nomura.
